review.notes: No code fences in the OCR output. Full normalized text-layer diff of all 29 physical pages against the OCR Markdown; unmatched residue is display math/figure-internal text and the PDF's own typos (kept). The systematic defect was droppage of all 15 page-bottom footnote URL bodies while the superscript markers survive in the body. Every footnote block (physical pages 1, 4, 6, 7, 9) was rendered at 300 dpi and the restored URLs were transcribed and verified from those renders, including the printed double 'experimental/experimental' path segment of footnote 4.
